design_philosophy: Awwwards-level Brutalist Gaming. Structural honesty, high-contrast typography, and purposeful negative space. NO GRADIENTS. Elite, authoritative, non-AI aesthetic.

rules: CRITICAL: NO GRADIENTS ANYWHERE. Do not use bg-gradient, text-gradient, or soft glowing blurs.
Use #2742F5 for CTAs, active states, and structural accents.
Use rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.1) for 1px hairline borders to separate layout grids.

typography.headings: Clash Display, Unbounded, or Bebas Neue
typography.mono: JetBrains Mono or Space Mono (For UID, numbers, stats, and small labels)

hierarchy.h1: text-5xl md:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none uppercase

visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10. Grid-like layouts (Swiss brutalist pattern).
visual_enhancers.corners: Sharp edges. Use rounded-none or maximum rounded-sm.
visual_enhancers.shadows: DO NOT USE soft shadows. Use hard 1px borders or solid drop-shadow offsets (e.g. 4px 4px 0px #2742F5).
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Avoid standard muddy glass. If needed, use extremely subtle bg-black/60 with backdrop-blur-xl and 1px hard border-white/10.

marketing_landing.hero: Kinetic hero section with masked line-by-line reveal text. High contrast, large bold statements. Include abstract 3D cube or geometric graphics.
marketing_landing.manifesto: Numbered chapters (01, 02, 03). Huge typography on left, text on right. Use Framer-motion scroll-reveals (fade up + subtle parallax).
marketing_landing.marquee: Slow editorial marquee. font-mono. Text like 'VQT CLIENT • HIGH PERFORMANCE • UNDETECTED • '
marketing_landing.shop: 3-column grid for licenses (30 dni, 90 dni, lifetime). Highlight the lifetime plan with the #2742F5 accent color.

dashboard.structure: Grid/Bento layout. High density but with generous padding inside cards (p-6 or p-8).
tabs: Profile: Avatar, Name, UID, About me
Account & Security: Email, Password change, Discord connect button, 2FA toggle
Payment History: Data table with simple, brutalist borders
Download: Big primary button with the file download link

components.buttons: Rectangular, sharp edges (rounded-none). Hard hover states (e.g. hover:bg-white hover:text-black) instead of soft fades. Primary CTA must use #2742F5.
components.inputs: Flat bg (#0A0A0A), sharp corners, 1px border-white/10. Focus state: border-[#2742F5].
components.cards: Flat background. No soft shadows. Rely on 1px borders for definition.
components.navigation: Sticky top bar, z-50, dark glassmorphism (bg-[#050505]/80 backdrop-blur-xl). Must have Logo, Shop, Login/Dashboard links, and Language switch.

motion.scroll: Use Lenis for smooth scrolling. Momentum and weight are critical for premium feel.
motion.reveals: Staggered text reveals (framer-motion). Elements should translate from Y offset with 0 opacity to full opacity on scroll.
motion.hover: Instant or very fast (150ms) state changes to feel responsive and 'hacker/gamer' like. No lazy slow hovers.

hero_abstract.description: Abstract geometric neon cubes for hero section visual

manifesto_graphic.description: Abstract blue tunnel for scroll-reveal sections

dashboard_mockup.description: Dark gaming setup to represent the elite client feel

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #2742F5 and #FFFFFF pass APCA contrast against #050505.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) MUST include data-testid attributes.

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: You are building a Minecraft cheat client store and dashboard (Vqt). Use ONLY pure #050505, #FFFFFF, and #2742F5. NO GRADIENTS anywhere. Implement Framer Motion for scroll reveals and kinetic typography. Use standard HTML/Tailwind for the landing page (Bento grids, raw divs) and Shadcn for the Dashboard (Tables, Tabs, Forms) heavily customized to remove border-radius and soft shadows. Build the full routing: Landing -> Auth -> Dashboard.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: 1. Never use gradients. 2. Implement Lenis smooth scroll. 3. Use 2-3x more padding than usual (e.g., p-12, py-24). 4. Do not center-align everything; use strict grid-based optical alignment. 5. Include data-testid on all key interactive elements. 6. Make it feel premium, brutalist, and highly technical. 7. Do not use transparent backgrounds under text. 8. All mockups/graphics must be treated like high-end product photography.
